question: What constitutes the root Kaula attainment together with the eight powers?
premises: The eight powers are enumerated as attained.
The attainment of powers is linked with the root Kaula.
This teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight powers is identified as belonging to the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight powers is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: And the eight powers, along with their attainment, constitute the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
